findings.note_span: Reports diarrhoea and unsteadiness; no vomiting or confusion.
findings.rationale: The note incorrectly documents the patient reporting diarrhoea and unsteadiness when the transcript shows the patient denied these symptoms.

findings.transcript_evidence: Because you've taken naproxen, I'd like to recheck your lithium level in one week, 12 hours after your evening dose. After that we'll go back to every three months.
findings.rationale: The note omits the immediate recheck plan (one week) and incorrectly states the follow-up interval as three months, missing the interim step.
